body:
Thick 400g greeting cards use heavyweight cardstock with a substantial, rigid feel that conveys prestige before the envelope is even opened. The extra weight signals care and importance, which is why milestone occasions and luxury brands keep coming back to it.

Wedding invitations, New Year cards, and milestone celebrations — anniversaries, graduations, and significant birthdays — all benefit from a card that feels like an object rather than a slip of paper. When guests hold a 400g invitation, the event itself feels more considered.

For brands, the heavyweight stock makes a memorable leave-behind in gifting programs and executive correspondence. Add foil stamping, spot UV, or embossing and the card layers on even more luxury, turning a simple message into a tactile statement piece.

Each card is printed on 400g ultra-thick coated paper — about 1.3 times the thickness of a standard card — in the 127×178mm standard size. Four-color offset printing with ICC color management keeps colors rich and consistent, and finishing options include matte or gloss lamination, foil stamping, and embossing, with a free die-cut check before production.

Pricing is HK$120-220 per 100 cards, with a 100-card minimum order. A free design check and free sample are included, paper is FSC certified, and production follows ISO 9001 quality control. Cards ship direct from our Asia factory via DHL Express in 2-4 days worldwide, and a free design mockup plus a 30-second AI quote with no setup fees get you started.

**FAQ**

**Q1: What makes 400g paper special?** It is roughly 1.3 times the thickness of standard cardstock, giving a rigid, prestigious feel.

**Q2: Can I add foil, UV, or embossing?** Yes, foil stamping, spot UV, and embossing are all available options.

**Q3: Is the size compatible with standard holders?** Yes, the 127×178mm format fits regular card sleeves and holders.

Ready to order your thick cards? Get a free digital proof within 1 hour — WhatsApp +86 198 8085 1334 or click the "30-second AI quote" button on the page.
